Business consultancy

Business consultant or business analyst?

The job titles overlap. Start by stating the decision you need to make and the work that someone must do to support it.

In this guide
When the direction is unclearWhen a change needs definingAgree on the handoff

When the direction is unclear

A consultant can help a leadership team compare options, challenge an assumption and choose a course of action. For example, a retailer deciding whether to expand deliveries needs a view of demand, capacity and operating cost.

When a change needs defining

An analyst can follow the current workflow, collect requirements and test whether the proposed change will meet them. In the delivery example, that might mean tracing an order through stock allocation, dispatch and customer updates.

Agree on the handoff

Ask both candidates what they would deliver in the first phase. A team may need a recommendation first, followed by a detailed specification that its staff or software supplier can implement.
